# OmniCloud Labs

> Independent digital publishing and software studio based in Florida, United States.

## Key Products & Properties
- **GrantDossier** (https://grantdossier.com): Verified IRS Form 990 foundation research dossiers and grant-ready application templates for US 501(c)(3) nonprofits.
- **Can I Go Boating Today?** (https://canigoboatingtoday.com): Live US coastal marine weather, wind, wave, and NOAA tide forecasts across 63 coastal hubs.
- **My Huge Book of Coloring** (https://myhugebookofcoloring.com): Original printable and paperback coloring books for kids and adults.
